<!--
Put the issue number after the `#` above. Behaviour changes need an issue that
a maintainer has labelled `design-approved` before the pull request can be
reviewed or merged — see CONTRIBUTING.md for why the design conversation comes
first. A maintainer can label the pull request `trivial` instead when there is
genuinely no design to agree.

Leave the line as `Approved issue: #<number>`. It links the approved issue
without closing it: GitHub would close the issue as soon as this pull request
merges if the line used a closing keyword, and maintainers close issues when
the fix ships instead. `Refs #<number>` works too; a bare `#<number>` in prose
does not count.
